# fossa_team (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_role_id` (Number) Default role ID for team members
- `name` (String) Name of the team

### Optional

- `auto_add_users` (Boolean) Whether to automatically add users to this team
- `unique_identifier` (String) Unique identifier for the team

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The team's creation date
- `id` (Number) The team's unique identifier
- `organization_id` (Number) The organization's unique identifier
- `team_members_count` (Number) The number of members in the team
- `team_oidcproviders_count` (Number) The number of OIDC providers that can be accessed by members of this team. Includes both org-scoped providers and
team-scoped providers where the scopeId matches the team ID. This property is only returned if the user has
permission to view OIDC providers.
- `team_projects_count` (Number) The number of projects associated with the team
- `team_release_groups_count` (Number) The number of release groups associated with the team
- `team_type` (String) Whether it's a normal team or a Team Group.
- `team_users` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--team_users))
- `updated_at` (String) The team's last update date

<a id="nestedatt--team_users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `team_users`

Read-Only:

- `role_id` (Number) The role's unique identifier
- `user_id` (Number) The user's unique identifier
